votes.motion: To nominate Commissioner Alder as Chair for 2021, Commissioner Alder accepted that nomination
To nominate Commissioner Breinholt as Vice Chair for 2021, Commissioner Breinholt accepted that nomination
To approve the September 23, 2020 Planning Commissioner Meeting Minutes as presented

To recommend file #OAM2021-000427 for a proposed ordinance creating Chapter 19.15 of the Copperton Code of Ordinances allowing for and regulating Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) and Interior Accessory Dwelling Units (IADUs) to the Copperton Council for approval as presented with recommended formatting and date changes discussed for consistency

To recommend file #OAM2021-000429 for a proposed ordinance removing square footage limits in the R-1 Zones for accessory structures in the Copperton Code of Ordinances Section 19.14 to the Copperton Council for approval as presented with recommended changes discussed

To recommend file #OAM2021-000428 for a proposal to amend the existing Floodplain Ordinance in Section 19.74 of the Copperton Code of Ordinances. This update will replace the existing Section 19.74 with new language that conforms with current State of Utah and FEMA requirements to the Copperton Council for approval as presented with recommended changes discussed
